I am an old woman, and my maize plot is very small — only a small corner of my land. I will put a little DAP fertilizer when I plant, because maize gives nothing without it, but I cannot afford the full bag the extension man recommends. I also spread the manure from my animals on this plot because it is close to the house. I will save my own seed like I always do, and my children will help me weed and harvest, though I may pay a neighbor a few days at harvest since my back is not what it was.
